assessments.summary: The exact certificate decodes to 152 distinct points in the 76×76 grid, and exhaustive exact-integer determinant testing establishes that no three are collinear. Embedding this grid into the 77×77 grid proves D(77) ≥ 152. The row-line argument gives D(77) ≤ 154, establishing 152 ≤ D(77) ≤ 154.
scopeQualifications: The external database provenance and the database-specific interpretation of the initial 'o' marker were not independently established, but neither is needed for the mathematical certificate once the payload is decoded and verified.
